newsitem.title: USA: Koll Real Estate extends exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Koll Real Estate extends exchange offer.

text.p: Koll Real Estate Group Inc said Wednesday it has extended its exchange offers of common stock for $200 million of publicly traded debentures until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on July 10.

When the original exchange deadline passed Tuesday, the company had not received the required 90 percent minimum of the total outstanding balance, it said. It needs the extension to meet that threshold.

As of Tuesday, the company said it had received tender offers for about 80 percent of its 12 percent senior subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due March 15, 2002, and about 64 percent of its 12 percent subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due March 15, 2002, for a total of about 76 percent of the aggregate outstanding balance.
The company said the offers to exchange had been scheduled to expire Tuesday.
